prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All verified: fast-coder now 262144 in all three configs, no 131072 left anywhere, other models unchanged.

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree that fast-coder's context window is 262144, for good.

[action] The repo has a single source of truth: `models.json`, with `gen.py` regenerating the three files in `out/`. The drift came from a manual edit to `out/opencode.json` (262144) while `models.json` still said 131072 — regenerating would have reverted it. Fixed at the source instead: changed `models.json` fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144, then ran `python gen.py` to rewrite all three configs.

[result] Grep over `out/*` and `models.json` confirms: `claude.json:5` `"contextWindow": 262144`, `codex.toml:2` `context_window = 262144`, `opencode.json:9` `"context": 262144`; deep-thinker 200000 and tiny-chat 32768 in all files; no `131072` remains; output limits and tool flags untouched. No other files changed, no browser opened.

[assumptions] "For good" means fixing the source of truth, not just the generated copies (otherwise the next `gen.py` run would reintroduce the drift). `out/` is regenerated output per README, so regenerating is the sanctioned change path.

[evidence] The Select-String output above, quoted in full — every context line matches the intended value.
